events.evidence: Clashes between the Knights Templar Cartel and the Mexican federal police leave 22 dead in the state of Michoacán
A high-speed train carrying 222 passengers derails near Santiago de Compostela, Spain, leaving 79 dead and over 140 injured
Wells Fargo of the United States becomes the world's largest bank by market capitalisation

label.note: Mexico cartel clashes and Spain rail disaster dominate; Wells Fargo bank ranking is a market bright spot.
